reason: The code change itself is correct for the 65SC12: all opcodes real (DEC A, SBC (zp), BRA are 65C02; no Rockwell ops). Recount: the common path goes from 28 to 26 cycles after STA (v_ptr),Y, so it saves 2. The rare page-crossing path goes from 32 to 35. Branch ranges assemble: BCS each_cross is -33, BRA on_same_page +29, BEQ empty -73, BMI clip_test -77, BPL/BCC draw_column.each 91/78. The arithmetic is the same, including count>=254. But the 21 bytes it adds to bank 4 (12 of them the SKIP pad) break other builds. I assembled HEAD 9f97ad5 with and without the edit in a private copy. Shipping config: OK. SKY_HELI=0 (the decision-36 kind cache build, make DEFINES=SKY_HELI=0): fails with 'bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 12' (the control has 9 bytes spare, PAD_END at &B3F7). DEBUG_FULLREDRAW=1, the proof gate's oracle: fails with 'overruns by 14' (the control has 7 spare). The oracle not assembling means the gate cannot run, and CLAUDE.md requires every flag set to build. The alignment claim is also incomplete. With the code after .each moved 21 bytes: BPL raised, BCC up_cell, BEQ in_hazel, BNE gather and BEQ gathered stop crossing a page. But BNE whole_pages (compact's inner byte-copy loop, about +255 cycles for each whole page copied), the outer BNE whole_pages, BRA rest, BEQ no_part (restore's each_part loop), BRA y_known and four BCS fall in the sky checks start crossing. Those costs are not listed in relies_on and come as spikes on compact passes, not in the mean. Even the unpadded ALT 3 (+9 bytes) would leave the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build 2 bytes over.
